origin.description: Record how a package was obtained by merging fields into its DESCRIPTION.

arguments.name: meta
arguments.text: Named list of fields. A value overwrites the same name. NULL drops the field. A nested list updates that field element by element.

origin.details: DESCRIPTION is read as DCF and written back with every field kept white, so continuation lines stay in the file. A blank line in a value is written as a line containing a dot. If Meta/package.rds exists, that DESCRIPTION vector is updated the same way and stored with saveRDS.
origin.value: NULL, invisibly. The result is the updated file.
origin.example:
pkg <- tempfile("addmeta")
dir.create(file.path(pkg, "Meta"), recursive = TRUE)
saveRDS(structure(list(DESCRIPTION = c(Package = "foo", Version = "1.0.0")), class = "packageDescription2"), file.path(pkg, "Meta", "package.rds"))
add_metadata(pkg, list(RemoteType = "github", RemoteRepo = "foo"))
desc <- readRDS(file.path(pkg, "Meta", "package.rds"))$DESCRIPTION
cat("readRDS()$DESCRIPTION is Package foo, Version 1.0.0, RemoteType github, RemoteRepo foo.\n")
cat(sprintf("%s: %s\n", names(desc), desc), sep = "")

translation.description: Record how a package was obtained by merging fields into its DESCRIPTION.

arguments.name: meta
arguments.text: Dict of fields. A value overwrites the same name. None drops the field. A nested dict updates that field element by element.

translation.details: DESCRIPTION is read as DCF and written back with every field kept white. A newline that is not followed by space or tab gains a space, and a blank line becomes a line containing a dot. If Meta/package.rds exists, its DESCRIPTION vector is updated the same way and written as an RDS file that readRDS accepts.
translation.value: None. The result is the updated file.
translation.example:
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from remotes.add_metadata import add_metadata
pkg = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(pkg, "Meta"))
rds = os.path.join(pkg, "Meta", "package.rds")
subprocess.check_call(["Rscript", "--vanilla", "-e", "saveRDS(structure(list(DESCRIPTION = c(Package = 'foo', Version = '1.0.0')), class = 'packageDescription2'), commandArgs(TRUE)[[1]])", rds])
add_metadata(pkg, {"RemoteType": "github", "RemoteRepo": "foo"})
text = subprocess.check_output(["Rscript", "--vanilla", "-e", "d <- readRDS(commandArgs(TRUE)[[1]])$DESCRIPTION; cat(sprintf('%s: %s\\n', names(d), d), sep = '')", rds], text=True)
print("readRDS()$DESCRIPTION is Package foo, Version 1.0.0, RemoteType github, RemoteRepo foo.")
print(text, end="")
